customers.evidence: Improving quality is a daily priority at Ford. From design and manufacture to sales and service, Ford always aims to increase customer satisfaction.

employees.evidence: we continued to fund our employee pension plans worldwide, delivered record profit-sharing contributions to our U.S. hourly employees

environment.evidence: our commitment to sustainability is a key part of our company DNA

community.evidence: Community service is an important part of Ford’s heritage and always has been.

integrity.evidence: Alessandra’s work on Ford’s global supply chain goes further than U.S. Conflict Minerals Law compliance.

safety.evidence: We have a longstanding commitment to developing and implementing innovations that make our vehicles safer for our customers and their families.

innovation.evidence: Innovation is at the core of our company.

result.analyst_notes: Promotional, aspirational tone with absolute claims such as always and daily priority. Mostly third-person Ford, with some first-person plural we. Leads with products, innovation and sustainability; growth and profit are framed alongside. Hedged phrasing appears only in aims to and plans are under way. Distinctive slogan Go Further recurs.
